Folate is a nutrient that helps the body make DNA and RNA and is important for making new cells (https://www.whittington.nhs.uk/mini-apps/leaflet?id=374). It is found in leafy green vegetables, fortified breakfast cereals, pulses, fruit such as oranges and avocados, and fruit and vegetable juices (https://www.dryoungandpartners.scot.nhs.uk/page1.aspx?p=18&t=1). The reference intake for adults is 200 μg per day (https://www.hey.nhs.uk/patient-leaflet/folate-information-for-renal-patients-information-to-increase-folate-in-your-diet).
